tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa'i rnam bzhag bogs 'byin sbyin sreg bcas bzhugs so// swasti/ 'jam dpal ye shes nyi ma rmongs pa'i dgra/ /dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed khro bo'i gshed/ /'dzag med liṅga rgyas pa chags pa'i sman/ /dug gsum gshin rje kun 'joms bla ma rgyal/ /gang gi go 'phang myur du thob pa dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bstan 'gro skyong ba'i phyir/ /bsnyen pa'i rnam bzhag bogs 'byin sbyin sreg bcas/ /dang po'i las can don du bshad kyis nyon/ /'di la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags bzhi 'bum/ snying po 'bum bcu/ nye snying 'bum bdun rnams so so'i kha skong bcas bsnyen pa byas tshe zla ba gsum tsam la 'gro'am snyam pas de'i tshul ni mtshams g.yog gcig gnyis dang / phung po'i 'phrod bsten sman pa 'phrad dgos byung na ma gtogs gzhan 'grim 'grul bcad/ mtshams khang dang mthun rkyen rnams 'dzoms shing rang dbang 'du bar byed pa sogs thog mtha' bar gsum gyi zhib cha tshang ma 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdor bsnyen yig sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab bzhin shes par byas la/ skabs don rang kha lhor phyogs pa'i g.yas sam mdun gang bder 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi bris 'bur gang rung 'byor na bzhugs su gsol/ ma 'byor na'ang skyon med/ gang ltar stegs bang rim can ras sogs kyi khebs ldan/ 'bru bkram pa'i steng / snod lngar chang chu sha khrag bdud rtsi ril bu tsam pa sogs lhan cig sbrus pa'i zlum gtor mtheb kyu can sha mar gyi rgyan ldan lnga bshams/ rang re'i phyag len la bskang ba dril gsil ma'ang spro na byed pas skabs mtshams su byed pas skabs su byed na bkram bskang bsdus bskang gang rung bshams drung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod dang / bskang gtor med tshe zlum gtor lnga'i drung du mchod pa bshams/

mchod gtor gso chas rdor dril sogs gang dgos 'dus byas/ gshin po sogs kyi longs spyad pa ma yin pa'i thod pa'am ru rakṣa'am ma 'byor na bo dhi tsitta'i phreng ba grangs 'dzin bcu shad mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bcas/ zla ba gang rung gi nyer gsum lnga dgu gang rung la dgong thun nas dbu btsugs te gnas yo byin rlabs dkyil chog rab gsal snang ba las 'byung ba bzhin/ nged rang nas drug cu'i gtong deb tu bkod pa ltar dang / mngon rtogs yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo bcas zhal dkar bas bdud 'joms snang ba'i gter mdzod bzhin shes par byas la/ rang re'i gtor bsngo chen mo'ang byed par spro na/ de'i tshul drug cu'i gtong deb na gsal/ gang ltar thun bzhi ma stabs bde bas tshugs pa'i dgong thun/ srod thun/ de'i sang thor thun snga thun rnams la skyabs 'gro ci 'gro bsags nas mngon rtogs bzlas pa zhar byung bya/ thun 'dzin tshul des zhag gcig yig brgya la grangs bzung / maṇḍal grangs gsog sa lo'i phyag len la med/ de phyin gyi thun thams cad dngos gzhi'i bzlas pa la grangs bzung / thor snga srod gsum thun la gtor ma dang po dang / gsum bzhi rnams gsos la/ sbyangs bdug dang 'jigs byed phyogs skyong las gshin rnams kyi gtor bsngo bya zhing / las gshin la bzlas pa ma byas kyang chog pas gtor bsngo rdzogs 'phral rjes chog bya/ tshe sgrub sogs thugs dam gzhan yod tshe phal cher thor thun grub nas/ snga thun gyi 'gor bya/ snga thun grub nas gung tshigs/ dgong thun dang rjes 'brel yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo yod na'ang bya zhing / gtso bor tshig rjes la shes pa hril gyis 'gro ba dang / 'don cha gang yin la lhag chad med cing dag pa ni shin tu gal che/ yi dam 'di drag po'i las la mngags pas stod na zhing tshig pa za ba dang / 'jigs snang sogs shes pa gnad du mi phebs pa tsam yong yang / thugs ka'i sngags 'khor dang bskyed rim gyi gsal snang la sgrim pa'i mu nas de'i ngang la lhod de bzhag

des kyang mi zhi ba tsam byung tshe spyi bo'i bla ma rigs bdag la thugs rjes gzigs shig snyam pa'i mos dung dang / skabs re bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi rnam rtog ci yang yid la mi bya bar cham me bzhag re 'ga' bzlas pa'i sgra la sems gtad gzhan yang zas spyod byings rgod sel ba'i thabs sogs gang la gang dgos bsnyen yig gzhan ltar shes par byas nas dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin byas pas rang gi brtson 'grus dang skal ba'i dbang gis mtshan sku mthong ba gsung thos pa ting nge 'dzin skye ba sogs dngos nyams rmi lam gang rung du 'byung ngo // ma'i bsnyen pa'ang ci rigs 'grub par 'gyur ro// //dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa'i rnam bzhag bogs 'byin sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
